.. class:: infomark
**What this tool does**
Sends values from a selected column of a tabular input file to the EBI ZOOMA service and returns normalized tabular results.
**Supported API modes**
- **Annotate**: Uses the legacy endpoint ``/spot/zooma/v2/api/services/annotate`` and queries with ``propertyValue``. - **Map**: Uses the current v3 endpoint ``/spot/zooma/v3/api/services/map`` and submits values in a JSON ``properties`` payload.
**Service availability check**
Before processing input rows, the tool calls ``/spot/zooma/v3/api/health``. If the service is unavailable, the job fails early with a clear error message instead of producing partial output.
**Batching**
Query values are processed in batches of the configured *Batch size*.
- In **Map** mode a batch is submitted as a single API request, so larger batches mean fewer requests. ZOOMA answers with one mapping per submitted value and the wrapper checks that the response lines up with the request before writing anything. - In **Annotate** mode the legacy endpoint only accepts one value per request, so a batch is a group of sequential requests. It is still processed, retried and skipped as a single unit.
**Retries and skipped values**
If a batch fails it is retried once. If it fails again its values are skipped, a ``WARNING`` line is written to the job output naming the batch and how many values were dropped, and processing continues with the next batch. If two batches fail one after another the job fails, because the service is then considered unavailable.
Values are therefore only missing from the output if their batch failed twice, and every such event is reported in the job output. Note that ZOOMA rejects any single value longer than 1000 characters, which will always fail the batch containing it.
**Output**
The output table contains one row per returned result candidate and includes: ``query``, ``property_value``, ``property_type``, ``semantic_tags``, ``confidence``, ``source_name``, ``source_type``, and ``study_type``.
